# Research method

**Where do ideas and references come from?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C25


## Study one same-niche creator deeply
<a id="one-creator-deep"></a>

Download and measure one creator's reels: cuts, beats, loudness, hooks, CTAs.

**Looks like:** Twelve reels measured with ffmpeg and Whisper, giving a table of what this creator does every time and what drives their outliers.

**Good at:** precise, measurable craft; niche fit; benchmarks

**Weak at:** risk of copying one style; narrow view of the feed

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, trust · effort high

**How:** yt-dlp for study only, then ffmpeg scene detection, EBU R128 loudness and contact sheets.

**Backed by:** [Study one same-niche creator deeply](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-study-one-creator-deeply), [Measure reference reels with code](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-measure-reels-pipeline), [Download references for local analysis](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-yt-dlp-references), [Trial Reels test hooks on non-followers](../topics/growth.md#growth-trial-reels), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s) · sources R1

## 5 in-niche for topics, 5 outside for packaging
<a id="five-plus-five"></a>

Take topics from niche peers and formats, angles and series from creators in other niches.

**Looks like:** A gym topic packaged like a finance creator's whiteboard series. Nobody in the niche has seen that combination.

**Good at:** originality; fresh packaging; fast ideation

**Weak at:** needs curation; outside formats may not fit

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals reach, follows · effort medium

**How:** Keep two saved collections on Instagram: topics and packaging.

**Backed by:** [5 in-niche for topics, 5 outside for packaging](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-5-plus-5-creators), [Expertise hook: years of niche in 60 seconds](../topics/hooks.md#l11-expertise-hook), [Outlines and mechanisms: blitz, storytime, opinions](../topics/story.md#story-controversial-outline), [Make it concrete and visual](../topics/text.md#text-zoom-in-concrete) · sources L08

## Study the viewer's whole feed
<a id="whole-feed"></a>

You compete with everything in the feed. Make an account that follows what your ideal viewer follows, and copy only true outliers.

**Looks like:** Fifteen minutes a day scrolling a second account full of skits, memes and creators the audience loves. Ideas come from what beats its own creator's average.

**Good at:** shareability; trend awareness; outside-niche ideas

**Weak at:** time-consuming; noisy

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals reach, shares · effort medium

**How:** A second Instagram account. Note outliers at 2× or more of their creator's average.

**Backed by:** [You compete with the whole feed](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-compete-with-feed), [Copy only true outliers](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-outliers-vs-own-average), [Three Instagram strategies](../topics/brand.md#brand-instagram-strategies), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall) · sources L07, L08

## Audience questions and niche forums
<a id="audience-questions"></a>

Ideas from repeated comment and DM questions, objections, and top posts in niche subreddits.

**Looks like:** Five people ask 'which RAM for this board?' and that becomes a reel. A top-of-month subreddit thread becomes a myth-bust.

**Good at:** demand is proven; trust (answering real people); saves

**Weak at:** needs an audience or forum access; less trend-driven

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals saves, trust · effort low

**How:** Log repeated questions weekly. Summarise top subreddit posts with AI.

**Backed by:** [Ideas from DM and comment questions](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-audience-questions-not-polls), [Idea faucets: Reddit and your own winners](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-reddit-faucet), [Answer objections inside the content](../topics/story.md#story-answer-objections), [Expertise hook: years of niche in 60 seconds](../topics/hooks.md#l11-expertise-hook), [First 60 minutes after posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-first-60-minutes) · sources L05, L08, L07

## Trend scan
<a id="trend-scan"></a>

Track trending formats, audio and release dates across niches, and adapt the format rather than copying the video.

**Looks like:** A weekly report: GTA 6 countdowns, a gym myth-rebuttal proof reel, a trending sound at 'growing' stage. Pick one and add your own flavour.

**Good at:** timeliness; reach on rising formats; calendar of upcoming moments

**Weak at:** trends die in 1–4 weeks; can pull away from your core

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals reach · effort medium

**How:** Run the researcher (brain/research/RESEARCHER.md); trends.json holds the output.

**Backed by:** ["You've probably seen X lately…"](../topics/hooks.md#hook-trend-riding), [Originality: no watermarks or near-duplicates](../topics/growth.md#growth-originality), [Trending audio only when it fits](../topics/sound.md#sound-trending-audio-fit), [Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example) · sources research, L04

## Mixing
Deep study gives craft; the 5+5 and whole-feed methods give packaging; questions give topics. They answer different parts of an idea.

## Rule of thumb
Craft benchmarks: one creator deep. Fresh packaging: 5+5 or whole feed. Proven demand: audience questions. Timely reach: trend scan.
